summary.en: Hikma's R&D is primarily generic and differentiated formulations across injectables, respiratory/nasal products and oral solids. Its named late-stage specialty opportunity is epinephrine nasal spray; most of the wider pipeline is undisclosed by asset.
summary.zh: Hikma的研发主要是注射剂、呼吸/鼻用产品和口服固体制剂的仿制药及差异化制剂。其明确的后期特药机会是肾上腺素鼻喷雾剂;更广泛管线的大部分未按资产披露。

next.en: Update on outcomes of epinephrine nasal-spray regulatory filings
next.zh: 肾上腺素鼻喷雾剂监管申报结果更新

watch.en: US, European and UK epinephrine filings were accepted; management expects to update on outcomes in 2027.
watch.zh: 美国、欧洲和英国的肾上腺素申报已获受理;管理层预计2027年更新结果。

watch.en: Hikma Rx expects broadly flat 2026 revenue as new launches offset greater competition in its base business.
watch.zh: Hikma Rx预计2026年收入大体持平,新品上市抵消了基础业务竞争加剧的影响。

watch.en: A key contract-manufacturing program is moving toward commercial production; its contribution depends on partner-product demand during 2027.
watch.zh: 一个重要的合同生产项目正走向商业化生产;其贡献取决于2027年合作伙伴产品的需求。

watch.en: Hikma targets R&D spending of 5–6% of revenue, versus 4.5% in 2025.
watch.zh: Hikma的研发支出目标为收入的5-6%,2025年为4.5%。

gaps: Only one named unapproved asset was verified; more than 300 pipeline products are reported in aggregate without conventional clinical phase totals.
Epinephrine nasal-spray origin, development code and receptor detail were not explicitly established and remain null.
